title: letcode configuration
description: Schema for ~/.config/letcode/letcode.toml, picked up by editors that understand the `#:schema` directive. Every level rejects unknown keys, mirroring the runtime parser.

active_provider.description: Provider used by the current session. Defaults to the first key under [providers] and must name a configured provider.

fast_mode.description: Skip non-essential retries and reasoning waits. Also toggled inside a session with /fast.

mcp.description: Model Context Protocol servers, one table per server.

providers.description: Model providers, one table per provider.

max_iterations.description: Maximum iterations within one interactive turn. Unbounded when omitted.

max_tool_calls.description: Maximum tool calls within one interactive turn. Unbounded when omitted.

tool_timeout_secs.description: Default timeout for ordinary tools in seconds. shell__exec keeps its own 300 second default.

sessions_dir.description: Session transcript directory, resolved relative to the configuration directory.

log_file.description: Runtime log file, resolved relative to the configuration directory.

preserve_recent_tokens.description: Tokens retained at the end of history during compaction. Derived from the model input budget when omitted.

enabled.description: Archive idle session transcripts in the background.

older_than_days.description: Idle days after which a transcript is archived. Archived sessions still resume.

retry.description: Physical retry policy. A provider level [providers.<name>.retry] inherits fields it does not declare from [global.retry].

max_attempts.description: Maximum attempts before an observable side effect; includes the first request.

max_recovery_attempts.description: Maximum controlled recovery iterations after partial output.

initial_delay_secs.description: Delay before the first retry; the fixed delay when exponential_backoff = false.

mode.description: safe asks for everything, default allows reads and asks for writes, auto answers approvals with the reviewer expert, yolo allows everything (solo is an alias).

parallelism.description: Per-tool concurrency override. Only narrows a tool that already declares Parallel; promoting an exclusive tool is rejected.

enabled.description: Also toggled inside a session with /mcp; the choice is written back here.

timeout.description: Response and method-call timeout in milliseconds.

command.description: Executable and arguments of a local stdio server. Required for type = "local".

environment.description: Environment variables passed to a local server. Aliased as `env`.

url.description: Endpoint of a remote server. Required for type = "remote".

headers.description: Extra request headers for a remote server.

oauth.description: Remote MCP OAuth is not supported; leave it false and authenticate through headers.

agents.description: Optional per-expert model routing. The key set is fixed; omitting provider makes the expert follow active_provider.

allowed_models.description: Routes offered to a single agent__* delegation, written as provider/model. Does not change the expert default route.

default_model.description: Model used when a route does not name one. Must be a key under this provider's [models].

reviewer.description: Marks the provider as an approval reviewer backend. The Jev reviewer requires auth.type = "bearer".

headers.description: Extra request headers. Reserved and duplicate headers are rejected.

query.description: Extra query parameters. Reserved and duplicate keys are rejected.

models.description: Model routes under this provider, keyed by model id.

protocol.description: Wire protocol. Adapter defaults apply when omitted.

flavor.description: Explicit provider profile. Never inferred from the provider or model name.

type.description: bearer sends Authorization: Bearer; header and query require `name`; none takes no credential.

name.description: Header or query parameter carrying the credential. Required by the header and query schemes.

credential.description: Literal credential. The environment variable named by credential_env takes precedence.

credential_env.description: Environment variable holding the credential. Defaults to <PROVIDER>_API_KEY.

base_url.description: Absolute http(s) URL without query parameters or fragments.

path.description: Protocol path overriding the adapter default. May be absolute.

query.description: Query parameters appended to the endpoint.

model_override.description: Wire model id sent upstream when it differs from the configuration key.

websocket.description: Use WebSocket transport for Responses agent turns when the endpoint supports it. One-shot requests stay on HTTP/SSE.

protocol_settings.description: Adapter-owned settings, validated by the selected protocol binding. Anthropic reads anthropic_thinking = { mode = "disabled" | "adaptive" | "budget", budget_tokens = <integer> } and anthropic_betas = [<string>]; both require protocol = "anthropic".

strategy.description: Model request strategy. Inferred from the model name when omitted.

capabilities.description: Declared model capabilities. Every flag defaults to false, and only flags declared here may be used under [generation].

reasoning.description: Must also be true when reasoning_effort or reasoning_efforts is set.

structured_output.description: json_schema constrains JSON syntax in the decoder; json_object only states the intent.

generation.description: Per-turn generation defaults. Each parameter must have its matching flag enabled under capabilities.generation first.

async_tools.description: Tool names dispatched asynchronously. Requires the Astra strategy, protocol = "responses" and capabilities.tools = true.

reasoning_effort.description: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max, or a provider specific value.

reasoning_efforts.description: Reasoning efforts offered to the session.

enabled.description: Sole switch for provider-native prompt caching on this route.

retention.description: Cache retention. 24h is Responses only and requires enabled = true.

fake.description: Request values used while the session level /fake switch is on. Every field is optional; absent values are derived from the real host or from the imitated client.

installation_id.description: UUID reported as the client installation id; generated and persisted when omitted.

timezone.description: IANA zone name, for example Asia/Shanghai.

extra.description: Free-form turn metadata keys, at most 16 entries. Keys are limited to 64 bytes starting with an ASCII letter; values are limited to 128 bytes. Keys already owned by the turn metadata (session_id, thread_id, turn_id, agent_name, request_kind, ...) are rejected.
